title: The Prophecy
subtitle: The Love Prompt of Devesh
opener_brief: OPENER TO GENERATE (no asset exists): 2:3 portrait, hand-lettered 'CHAPTER 13', title 'The Prophecy', subtitle 'The Love Prompt of Devesh' in blue. The chosen composition (from the approved variant): a curved wall of many identical timeline screens, each showing the same small figure leaving — except one screen, softly lit, where she stayed; a lone silhouetted figure (the Architect) stands before the wall, back to the reader. Sepia-blue watercolor, cinematic restraint, no cartoon on the screens yet — the Nickelodeon beat belongs to the ending, not the opener.

slots.anchor: Devesh ran a shady octopus meat caravan
slots.brief: Margin vignette: a crooked street-food caravan at dusk, strings of lights, a hand-painted octopus sign; from the serving window, one unmistakable tentacle rests on the counter beside the sauce bottles. Noir warmth.

slots.anchor: Devesh grinned and handed Norman two pills.
slots.brief: Small spot: a suckered tentacle offering two pills on an open cloth — one red, one blue — rendered like a jeweler's presentation. The homage is obvious; the tentacle makes it the book's own.

slots.anchor: Norman put a hand on his shoulder and handed him a photo.
slots.caption: Her, without makeup
slots.brief: Framed as a photograph within the page (photo-print border, slight tilt): an exploded NVIDIA H100 board, smoking silicon and copper traces, rendered in loving watercolor detail like a still life. Tragic and ridiculous at once.

slots.anchor: He switched that one to Nickelodeon.
slots.brief: Corner scene, the book's final image: the Architect from behind in his chair, forty dim timeline screens of her leaving — and one screen glowing warm with bright cartoon colors, the only color on the page. A cigarette burns down unattended. Do not show his face.
